programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Pitufos Y Solo Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido capturar a Pitufina. Ahora, se dispone a administrarle un suero de la verdad para descubrir todos los secretos de Papá Pitufo… pero Gargamel comete un gran error y le da a Pitufina una fórmula de las mentiras.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Secreto Del Pantano De Las Sombras
programme.desc: Pitufo Gruñón, que odia todo, detesta especialmente su propia fiesta de cumpleaños, por lo que decide esconderse en el Pantano de las Sombras. Allí encontrará extraños seres y vivirá aventuras aún más extrañas mientras los demás Pitufos le buscan…

programme.title: Pituplicación
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel crea una fórmula mágica que duplica todo aquello que toca. Y…¡sorpresa! ¡Ahora hay seis Pitufos Filósofos! Esto provoca algunas situaciones interesantes en la aldea… ¡Y también en casa de Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un dragón aterroriza la Aldea Pitufa. Para vencer al dragón, los Pitufos deben encontrar al famoso viajero chino. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo es capaz de entender las peculiares costumbres del extranjero, e incluso de hablar algunas palabras en su idioma.

programme.title: El Hombre De La Luna
programme.desc: Cansado y harto de que no le aprecien, el Hombre de la Luna deja su trabajo y se retira en la Tierra, en la Aldea Pitufa. La ausencia de la luna en cuarto creciente desata el caos en las costumbres de los Pitufos, y Madre Naturaleza y Padre Tiempo también se ven arrastrados por el embrollo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay un premio para aquel Pitufo que tenga la mascota más adorable. Bebé Pitufo acude con Cariño Dorado, una mascota adorable y cariñosa de la que todo el mundo se enamora. Sin embargo, esa mascota es una creación del malvado mago Gargamel con la que pretende destruir a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Símbolos De Sabiduría
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está desesperado por parecerse más a Papá Pitufo. ¿Podría ser la respuesta un tónico capilar? ¿Conseguirá Gargamel capturar por fin a los Pitufos? ¿Reside realmente la sabiduría en una barba?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se siente preparado para la ocasión cuando empieza a preparar una receta de galletas. Está convencido de que va a ganar el concurso, ya que ha tomado prestada una receta del libro de magia de Papá Pitufo. Sin embargo, una gran sorpresa y algunas situaciones desagradables aguardan al pobre Pitufo Filósofo y a toda la aldea.

programme.title: Secreto Del Pozo De La Aldea
programme.desc: ¿Por qué Pitufo Torpe espera día y noche junto al pozo de la aldea? ¿Cuál es el deseo que quiere mantener en secreto? ¿Y cómo está involucrado Gargamel en este asunto misterioso? ¿Logrará Gargamel atrapar por fin a los Pitufos?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos deben encontrar a una familia de conejos para tirar de su carroza durante el Festival de Otoño. Gargamel ve la oportunidad de capturar a los pequeños seres azules y se disfraza de conejo gigante. ¿Conseguirá atrapar a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo?

programme.title: Detente A Pitufar Rosas
programme.desc: La malvada hechicera Clorhidris quiere borrar todo el amor y la belleza de la faz de la tierra. Para ello, debe aniquilar la arboleda de los elfos de los bosques, donde la encantadora elfa muda Laconia cuida de las flores silvestres. Sin embargo, los Pitufos están ahí para salvar la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado Acechador, que captura animales silvestres para venderlos, tiene a Abuelo Pitufo y a Pitufo Salvaje de los nervios. Nana Pitufa y Smoogle acuden al rescate, capturando al Acechador en una de sus propias trampas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tras malinterpretar algo que oye, Pitufo Reportero publica que Gargamel desea ser amigo de los Pitufos. Gargamel convence a Pitufo Reportero para que le lleve hasta la Aldea Pitufa para hacer el anuncio en persona. Gargamel secuestra a los Pitufos, y Pitufo Reportero es ahora el responsable de escribir la historia de su rescate.

programme.title: Niñeras Chapuseras
programme.desc: Mientras Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo y Pitufo Goloso discuten, Hogata secuestra a Bebé Pitufo para preparar una fórmula para tener la piel suave como la de un bebé. Ellos tres, acompañados de Smoogle, tendrán que dejar a un lado sus rencillas para rescatar a Bebé Pitufo de las garras de Hogata.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel despide a Escrupuloso, que se va a vivir con Gigantón. Mientras los Pitufitos ayudan a Gigantón a organizar una fiesta, Escrupuloso los captura para congraciarse con Gargamel. Pero no cuenta con que Gigantón acudirá al rescate.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Por pura casualidad, un elefante que pasaba por el bosque se encuentra con Bebé Pitufo, y los Pitufos deciden crear un gran Circo. Van a visitar al hechicero infernal Baltazar y Bebé Pitufo se lo está pasando genial…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Epidemia De La Tos Saltarina
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Caballo Anaranjado De Los Zapatos De Oro
programme.desc: Deslizándose por un arcoíris, un caballito alado pierde una herradura dorada. Tras encontrarse con Pitufina, ambos van en su búsqueda. Al final, acaban encariñándose ya que quién podría resistirse al encanto de un caballito alado…o de Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algún tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a él. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorías en mente, todo se acaba enrevesándose.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una hermosa princesa resulta transformada en una bruja y necesita los bigotes de un gato y la lágrima de un Pitufo para preparar una poción mágica. Azrael, Pitufo Gruñón y Pitufo Bromista se convierten en colaboradores involuntarios y, cuando se produce la transformación mágica, la princesa les libera y regresan felices a su hogar.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Pitufos Leñadores
programme.desc: Un grupo de codiciosos leñadores planea talar el bosque del rey Gerard mientras se encuentra de vacaciones lejos de allí. Papá Pitufo disfraza a los Pitufos de fantasmas para espantar a los leñadores, que se rinden voluntariamente ante el rey cuando este regresa con su séquito.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Choza No Es Un Hogar
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza más grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del revés y esto le convence de que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Hay Que Atrapar Al Ladrón
programme.desc: Los Pitufos y Ómnibus se hacen amigos de un desdichado joven cuyo maestro le obliga a robar. Pronto, el malvado ladrón es entregado al magistrado y el joven está encantado de irse a vivir con Ómnibus.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan ocupados demostrando su propia fuerza de voluntad que no se dan cuenta de que Gargamel ha capturado a Pitufo Armonía. Papá Pitufo ofrece a Gargamel una caja con trampa para poner a prueba su fuerza de voluntad, lo que permite escapar a Pitufo Armonía.

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la superstición cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Goloso Y La Olla De Estofado
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: La Desgracia De Gargamel
programme.desc: Gargamel, el malvado e incompetente mago, intenta engañar a la gitana Esmeralda para que le dé una fórmula para atrapar a los Pitufos. Por supuesto, la gitana demuestra ser mucho más lista que Gargamel, y los Pitufos aún más.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Antes, en la Aldea Pitufa no había reloj. Sin embargo, el tiempo se ha convertido de repente en algo precioso, y Pitufo Vanidoso elabora un plan para aprovecharse del nuevo reloj de la aldea. ¿Podrán sobrevivir los Pitufos al ataque del tiempo?

programme.title: Fortachón Y Pitufina
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón descubre lo que es estar incapacitado cuando se rompe la pierna. Pitufo Carpintero crea para él una pitufisilla de ruedas, un invento que le proporcionará algo de movilidad a Pitufo Fortachón. Pero, de repente, el malvado mago Gargamel aparece en escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La repulsiva bruja Hogata captura a Pitufina. Quiere robarle a la pequeña belleza azul su cabello dorado. ¿Conseguirán salvar los Pitufos a su pequeña compañera antes de que sea demasiado tarde? ¿Logrará Hogata una cabellera como la de Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos Monstruosos
programme.desc: Es la noche de los fantasmas y todos los Pitufos se preparan para la elegante fiesta de disfraces… pero Pitufo Filósofo se hace con el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo y todos los Pitufos se transforman en criaturas horrendas, aunque divertidas. No obstante, el peligro acecha…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Pitufo Carpintero se encuentra con una anciana trol en el bosque, que le suplica que le ayude a librarse de un grano rojo que tiene en la nariz… ¡dándole un buen puntapié! Pitufo Carpintero la ayuda sin mucho convencimiento. Y el resultado resulta sorprendente para él.

programme.title: El Pitufo De Troya
programme.desc: Gargamel, el malvado mago, ha ideado un nuevo plan para capturar a los Pitufos: ha construido una estatua gigante con la forma de Papá Pitufo. Espera que, al verla, los Pitufos lleven la estatua a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El río Pitufo ha desaparecido: alguien lo ha congelado cerca de su nacimiento. Los Pitufos viajan hasta el país de la Emperatriz Esmeralda para descubrir cuál es el problema y se encuentran con el Oso Parches y los Piratas de Hierro.

programme.title: El Dulce Diente De Pitufina
programme.desc: Una vez al año, Pitufo Goloso prepara un lote especial de caramelos de pitufrutas. Cada Pitufo recibe provisiones para un año entero del dulce más pitufantástico de todo el mundo. Pero ¿puede un Pitufo conseguir que sus provisiones le duren todo el año? ¿Lo conseguirá Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel se siente seguro de sí mismo. Bueno, casi… ¡Está a punto de atrapar a los pequeños Pitufos! Las ligerísimas tortitas de Pitufo Goloso casi provocan que los Pitufos floten hasta quedar al alcance de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo lo ha vuelto a hacer. Además, esta vez ha sido delante de Papá Pitufo. Ha pronunciado un hechizo que convierte todo en piedra. Todo, incluyendo a él mismo y a los demás Pitufos, así como la aldea y muchos kilómetros del bosque que hay alrededor. Afortunadamente, aparece Guillermo.

programme.title: Narices Nuevas
programme.desc: A Pitufo Vanidoso no le gusta tener la misma nariz azul que el resto de los Pitufos. Necesita algo especial… Narizota, la prometida de Gigantón, también quiere cambiar su nariz. Y lo mismo le sucede a Gargamel. Así que se produce un intercambio de narices…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Denisa, la sobrina de Gargamel, se olvida la muñeca en su choza, y este la utiliza para lanzar un hechizo de control a Pitufo Goloso. Aunque Gargamel casi captura a los Pitufos, Papá Pitufo consigue cambiar las tornas y devuelve la muñeca a Denisa.

programme.title: Los Invitados Inesperados De Don Pitufo
programme.desc: Por culpa de Pitufo Filósofo, él mismo, Nana Pitufa y Pitufo Colérico acaban en un libro de aventuras de Don Pitufo. Si no consiguen escapar antes de la última página, quedarán atrapados en él para siempre. Mientras Pitufo Pintor usa su pincel para ayudarles a escapar de los peligros, Papá Pitufo trabaja contra el reloj para preparar una poción a tiempo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina y Nana Pitufa comparten casa y se sacan de quicio la una a la otra, así que ha llegado el momento de que Nana Pitufa tenga su propia casa. Mientras Nana Pitufa y Pitufina salen en busca de una planta calienta hogares, los demás diseñan la casa más pitufantástica posible para ella.

programme.title: La Fiesta De Denisa
programme.desc: Sasita acude a una fiesta en casa de Denisa. Pero Denisa la ignora cuando tres chicas mayores llegan a la fiesta. Sin embargo, Denisa descubre el auténtico significado de la amistad cuando las chicas mayores roban todos sus juguetes y Sasita la ayuda.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una emergencia, todos los Pitufos de la aldea dejan lo que tienen entre manos y corren a oír las noticias. Pero que Pitufo Vanidoso convoque una asamblea para que los Pitufos puedan admirar su nuevo gorro es pasarse de la raya. Le echan de la aldea y Pitufo Vanidoso tiene la mala suerte de encontrarse con Lofty, el elfo, que le recomienda darse un horrible baño de fango…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa extraña rana parlante que ha hecho que el hechicero Morlock haya enviado a todos los soldados del príncipe Teodoro para capturarla? ¿Es una rana demonio, como él dice? ¿O quizá lo hace por otro motivo? La verdad se desvelará cuando Pitufina y los Pitufitos se encuentran con la rana. Ayudan a la rana a volver a transformarse en el príncipe Teodoro, que había sido víctima de un hechizo lanzado por Morlock.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada 500 años, el Castillo Prisión aparece y secuestra a inocentes viajeros. Abuelo Pitufo despega en su globo hacia el castillo, donde se encuentra con Nana Pitufa, que lleva desaparecida 500 años. Tienen poco tiempo para escapar; de lo contrario, ¡se convertirán en invitados permanentes!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Tierra De Los Objetos Perdidos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón, Pitufo Carpintero y Pitufo Filósofo pierden el telescopio de Papá Pitufo y Scour, el señor de los objetos perdidos, lo encuentra. Los Pitufos le dicen que darían cualquier cosa por recuperarlo, y Scour se apropia así de sus posesiones más preciadas: su fortaleza, su habilidad y su inteligencia. Entonces, viajan hasta sus dominios para recuperar lo que han perdido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Némesis aparece en la Biblioteca de los Magos para robar el conocimiento de los Archivos del Mal y hacerse con la Piedra de la Longevidad. programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?

programme.title: Pitufos Leñadores

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Hay Que Atrapar Al Ladrón

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We play Blue's Clues to figure out what animal Blue wants to learn about. Throughout the episode, we learn about different animal behaviors by observing them and pretending to be them.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: All of our friends are pretending to be different occupations. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to be. We help Steve, who is pretending to be a reporter, figure out what occupations our various friends are.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Steve discovers his heartbeat with a stethoscope -- and Blue has discovered something too. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue has discovered.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Oh no! It's a hot summer day and Blue and Steve are composing a list of friends to invite to our pool party, but there's someone we forgot to invite! We play Blue's Clues to figure out who's missing from our list.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We spend the entire episode outdoors enjoying nature and playing Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to play. We identify herbs and help Mr. Salt and Paprika put together a bouquet, go on a walk, and play "I Spy."

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We're playing Blues Clues because we want to know what Blue invented. Steve wants to invent something, too, but he keeps inventing things that already exist!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Something kind of silly's going on at Steve and Blue's house and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what makes Blue laugh.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Steve and Blue are going on a big trip! We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to go. As we search for clues, we pack for our trip and learn about new environments.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: It's Blue's costume party and lots of silly spooky things are happening! Magenta doesn't have a costume, so we play Blue's Clues to help her figure out what to wear.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: It's a special nighttime game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do tonight. As we search for clues we join Shovel and Pail for a game and learn about the animals who are awake while we are asleep.

programme.title: Jackie Brown

programme.title: Bad Boys II

programme.title: God of War II

programme.title: Night Of The Assassin

programme.title: Superstar

programme.title: The Truman Show

programme.title: Charlie Bartlett

programme.title: Paris When It Sizzles
programme.desc: Richard Quine directs George Axelrod's acerbic script (adapted from Julien Duvivier's La Fête à Henriette) in this romantic comedy that reunites William Holden and Audrey Hepburn for the first time since 1954's Sabrina.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
programme.desc: Ma dreams of making a life in Shanghai without using his fist. But when he befriends the Boss of a rival gang, he must fight for honor or lose everything.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When the mob murders policeman Truman Gates' younger brother, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: Pearl: An X-traordinary Origin Story
programme.desc: Trapped on her family's isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter, overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in the movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx (Mia Goth) finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Who's Harry Crumb?
programme.desc: John Candy is bigger, better, and more bumbling than ever as a soft-headed private eye determined to crack a kidnapping case.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie

programme.title: Freeway [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: JCVD [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme gets involved in a bank robbery with hostages situation and reflects about his life during it.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow II [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A restauranteur teams up with a police officer and his ex-con brother to avenge the death of a friend's daughter.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: The Crush [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Dillinger And Capone [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist.

programme.title: L'île merveilleuse de Noël
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une tempête de neige détourne le premier vol privé de Kate vers Christmas Island, elle doit faire équipe avec un contrôleur aérien.

programme.title: Les fées de Noël
programme.desc: Tina est chargée d'organiser le gala de Noël annuel. Mais tout bascule quand l'événement risque d'être annulé.

programme.title: Les fées de Noël
programme.desc: Débordée par les responsabilités des Fêtes, Lily, propriétaire d'une boutique, accepte un rendez-vous avec un séduisant agent immobilier.

programme.title: Noël, sans filtre
programme.desc: À la suite d'un vœu fait la veille de Noël, Becky commence à dire à tout le monde, de façon involontaire, ce qu'elle pense réellement.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life

After a multi-day journey by air and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester's Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska's wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Rahn Hortman
programme.desc: Rahn credits the earliest influences to his humor to Bill Cosby and Martin Lawrence. Bill Cosby's ability to tackle diverse subject matter without uttering a single curse word, and Martin Lawrence's natural gift of representing the "ordinary guy" combined to form the foundation for Rahn's vision. What resulted is a unique blend of profanity-free banter, with pointed observations about everyday people that leave no one safe.

programme.title: Dom Irrera: Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Voted one of the hundred funniest comics of all time by Comedy Central, Philly native Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy special Live from Las Vegas. Dom's stand-up was honed while growing up in his big Italian family in South Philly. You've seen Dom in everything from Seinfeld, Everybody Loves Raymond, as a roaster on The Comedy Central Roast of Bruce Willis to his performance as Tony the limo driver in the Coen Brothers' cult favorite film The Big Lebowski. Dom is a fan favorite and a frequent guest on The Joe Rogan Experience. He also holds the record for the most live appearances of any comic on The Kill Tony Podcast. Dom Irrera: Live from Las Vegas proves why he is a comedy legend—and that “Laughter is the best medicine, except for actual medicine…”

programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Trio, Cannonball Adderley Quintet, Charles Mingus Sextet & Jimmy Smith
programme.sub-title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1972, an outstanding lineup played shoulder-to-shoulder at the 7th Newport Jazz Festival held in Rotterdam's then-recently built concert venue De Doelen. These four masterful groups consisted of alto saxophonist "Cannonball" Adderley and his quintet (Nat Adderley on cornet, George Duke on keyboards, Walter Booker on bass, and Roy McCurdy on drums), Hammond organist Jimmy Smith and his band (Art Farmer on flugelhorn, Illinois Jacquet on tenor saxophone, Kenny Burrell on guitar, Clark Terry on trumpet, and Roy Haynes on drums), pianist Dave Brubeck and his trio (Jack Six on bass, Alan Dawson on drums) with accompaniment from Paul Desmond on alto saxophone and Gerry Mulligan on baritone saxophone, and bassist Charles Mingus and his group (Joe Gardner on trumpet, Hamiet Bluiett on baritone saxophone, John Foster on piano, Roy Brooks on drums) with the great high-note trumpeter Cat Anderson as a guest.

programme.title: Milt Jackson
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Patitucci, Marco Pignataro, Joe Lovano & Terri Lyne Carrington
programme.sub-title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg's Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation's message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Kevin John Edusei
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and leads the orchestra in a beautiful performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's “A Midsummer Night's Dream”, Boulanger's “D'un matin de printemps” and Schumann's 'Spring' Symphony. Edusei is regularly praised for the drama and tension that he brings to his music-making, and for his clear sense of architecture and attention to detail.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Supertramp
programme.desc: Supertramp's “Breakfast In America” was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. It spawned several hit singles and went on to win two Grammy Awards and sell in excess of 20 million copies. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10 month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November. This show from the Pavillon de Paris was both filmed and recorded and now for the first time the full length audio and the concert film are combined in one set. The concert features the different song-writing styles of Roger Hodgson and Rick Davies, who each composed the songs on which they sing lead vocals.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. “Fred” Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass. Between them they also composed the vast majority of the band's many hit singles. Reuniting at the end of 2009 they released an eponymous album in 2010 and in November of that year they performed at the famous Roseland Ballroom in New York City as part of their North American tour.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon shares comprehensive garlic education on this Halloween-themed episode of Chewed Up, demonstrating proper peeling methods using a bowl-shaking technique, various cutting approaches including microplane mincing and hand-slicing, and the benefits of removing garlic germs to reduce bitterness. He advocates strongly for using whole fresh garlic rather than pre-peeled or jarred varieties, explaining how commercial processing compromises flavor. The episode culminates with preparation of luxurious Robuchon-style mashed potatoes—equal parts potatoes and butter—garnished with roasted garlic cloves, Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh chives, and served alongside grilled garlic bread.

programme.title: Chewed Up

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon takes center stage with his prized Prime Rib roast, walking through his technique for low-and-slow roasting and his signature horseradish cream sauce with sour cream and fresh grated horseradish. programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the costume design and fashion moments from Mike Nichols' 1988 film "Working Girl," starring Melanie Griffith, Sigourney Weaver, and Harrison Ford. The hosts explore how Ann Roth's costume choices—from Tess's working-class Staten Island attire to her polished corporate wardrobe—reflect her transformation from secretary to executive. They discuss iconic 80s trends including big hair, commuter shoes, bold eyeshadow, shoulder pads, and the evolution of her style throughout the film, analyzing how fashion serves as a character development tool.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London return to discuss costume design in the three-hour action film "One Battle After Another," exploring eight key looks worn by characters including revolutionary Perfidia Beverly Hills (Teyana Taylor), Bob Ferguson (Leonardo DiCaprio), and other ensemble cast members. The hosts praise costume designer Colleen Atwood's deliberate approach to wardrobe, analyzing how choices like safety orange camouflage, a pregnant character in military gear, and carefully detailed thrift-store aesthetics serve the story without becoming distracting. The conversation examines how costume design can be both detailed and subtly supportive of character development, comparing this film's approach to other cinema styles and discussing how clothing choices communicate character archetypes and backgrounds.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime: Chicken Meatloaf with Creamed Corn and Mashed Potatoes - Chef Keith Corbin joins Chris in the kitchen to put together another easy family-friendly meal: chicken meatloaf with a zesty creamed corn and garlicy, buttery mashed potatoes.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime: Niku Udon; Lemongrass-Caramel Chicken; Stir-Fried Angel Hair Pasta - Chris is in the kitchen to take you through three winning recipes from his rotation: A comforting udon noodle dish with thin slices of beef in a smoky, savory, slightly sweet broth; simple braised/stir-fried chicken that is somewhere between Vietnamese clay pot catfish and Taiwanese Three Cup Chicken; and a go-to quick pasta with tofu and veggies stir-fried in a flavor-packed sauce.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Sliders 3-ways, Because Kids Love Small Food: Kids love to eat small foods! It's a fact. Chris Ying shares three different ways he makes miniature burgers for his family, including Dad's Hacky BBQ Pork Char Siu, a ground pork slider and a traditional ground beef slider.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Fluffy, Buttery Biscuits for the Kiddos: Let's be clear: These are not the biscuits that chef Joshua Skenes used to serve at his three-Michelin-star restaurant Saison. Have I had those biscuits? Yes. Have I watched Josh make biscuits? Yes. Do I have his recipe in my phone? Maybe. Do I glance at that recipe whenever I set out to make biscuits for my kids? Well, wouldn't you? Jokes aside, Josh's biscuits are world-class, and are a product of not just the recipe, but his products and experience. I'm never gonna get them exactly right, but the ones I make are inspired by his. They're definitely passable and my kids can take them in whichever direction they like. My daughter likes it savory. My son likes them smothered in jam.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Sunday Gravy All Week: We don't need to tell you that kids like spaghetti and meatballs. Who doesn't? And Sunday gravy—with its chunks of fatty meat and sausage bobbing around in red sauce with the meatballs—is even better. Now, the real prize is what else you can do with that gravy. It's not just for lasagna and eggplant parm. Chris Ying shows you his Sunday Gravy recipe, and then how to take that same punchy, meaty, tomato-based umami sauce and use it to make beefy bean and cheese burritos and ratatouille.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Chris Ying cooks three easy breakfasts that you and (hopefully) your kids will love! The first recipe is for a physics-defying Swedish waffle that only has three ingredients (and are unbelieveably light and crispy). Next Chris makes a sticky rice omelette inspired by Nadine Levy Redzepi that is so simple and delicious. Just little chunks of Thai sticky rice fried crisp, then blanketed in egg. Finally Chris makes a family favorite—pork floss pancakes. These are similar to scallion pancakes and one of the best (and hackiest) paths to to Chinese breakfast pastries.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Stuffed Cabbage (It's Hiding a Giant Meatball!): Sometimes you just need to wrap a delicious meatball in something that makes you feel like you're giving your kids a vegetable. Maybe your kids will reject the cabbage wrapper and leave for you to snack on, or maybe this is the one time that convinces them that cabbage is amazing? Either way, Chris Ying shows you another go-to recipe that is easy and flexible—seasoned meatballs wrapped in cabbage leaves and cooked in a delicious, tomato-y broth.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Whole Roasted Chicken with Morgan McGlone: Our friend Morgan McGlone has cooked a lot of chicken—or "chook," as they call it in Australia, where he's from. He's a hell of a chef and restaurateur, as well as an excellent father to his son, Ryo. In this episode, he talks us through his roast chicken method, which, spoiler alert, involves a lot of butter. This is a bit of a long cook, so it's more of a weekend dish, but nothing beats breaking into a whole chicken with your family. The kids get to see food in its whole form, and pick the pices they want. The only decision you have to make is whether to share the best bits, or save them for yourself.

programme.title: Rick Steves European Easter
programme.desc: Taking you on a springtime journey through Spain, Slovenia, Italy, and Greece, we celebrate the 2,000-year-old story of Easter in a variety of cultures. Feel the emotion of Holy Week as we join solemn parades and raucous small-town festivities full of feasting and fireworks. Exploring a rich and fascinating mix of traditions — from Easter's pagan roots to its glorious finale — this one-hour special sheds new light on this timeless holiday.

programme.title: Rick Steves European Festivals
programme.desc: In this one-hour special, we drop in on Europe’s top 10 festivals. Joining Rick, we run with the bulls at Pamplona, don a mask in Venice for Carnevale, dance with Spaniards at the April Fair, cheer on the horses at Siena's Palio, hoist a frothy stein at Munich's Oktoberfest, toss a caber at a Scottish Highland Games, and more. No museums...just Europe at play.

programme.title: Rick Steves' Europe
programme.desc: In this first of two episodes on Europe’s greatest festivals, we’ll cheer with the masses at Siena's crazy Palio horse race, toss a caber at a Scottish Highland Games, don a mask for Carnevale in Venice, and celebrate Easter in Greece. Dropping in on some of the Continent’s top parties, we discover that each one is a celebration of traditional culture, and all of them are full of opportunities to sing and dance, feast on traditional food, and party with locals.

programme.title: Rick Steves' Europe
programme.desc: In this second of two episodes on Europe’s greatest festivals, we'll dance with Spaniards at Sevilla’s April Fair, celebrate Bastille Day in Paris, run with the bulls at Pamplona, and hoist a frothy stein at Munich’s Oktoberfest. And we’ll celebrate a traditional family Christmas, browsing the holiday market in Nürnberg and sledding down alpine slopes by torchlight in Switzerland. With the entire Continent as our playground, fun is our mission.

programme.title: Rick Steves' Europe
programme.desc: In Kraków — Poland's most rewarding destination — we linger on one of Europe's best squares, learn about St. John Paul II in neighborhood churches, and tour Wawel Castle, home to Poland's national cathedral. In Kazimierz, we learn the story of Poland's Jewish community, and in Nowa Huta, we explore a communist-era planned workers' town. Our climax is a powerful pilgrimage to the memorial at Auschwitz-Birkenau, the concentration camp where the Nazis killed more than one million innocent people.

programme.title: Rick Steves' Europe
programme.desc: Istanbul's rich heritage spans the centuries from Christian Byzantium to Muslim Ottoman rule to today's thriving city. We start our look back at the Roman-tinged Hippodrome, then indulge in the ancient ritual of the Turkish bath. We take in the Blue Mosque and the grand Hagia Sophia, taste Turkish delight at the venerable Spice Market, and explore Topkapı Palace and its harem room deep within.

programme.title: A Promise to My Father
programme.desc: A PROMISE TO MY FATHER follows Israel Izzy Arbeiter as he returns to the sites of his darkest hours and relives the Holocaust's unimaginable horrors. Arbeiters incredible story of survival unfolds in Nazi-occupied Poland, where the teenager lived with his family in the Jewish ghetto of Starachowice. Following his separation from his family, he endured life as a slave laborer in a German armaments factory and later, in numerous concentration camps throughout Europe, including the infamous Auschwitz-Birkenau. With his grandson in tow, Izzy travels to Treblinka, Auschwitz and Stuttof, and various Holocaust memorials, with the hope of bringing closure to this painful chapter of his life. He also visits his childhood home, now condemned, in the Polish city of Plock. Cameras follow the 87-year-old into the basement of the home, where he attempts to unearth family heirlooms hidden for decades.

programme.title: Eagles of Mercy
programme.desc: EAGLES OF MERCY recounts a seldom-told chapter in the World War II narrative, picking up in the opening moments of D-Day. In the early hours of June 6, 1944, two young American medics with the 101st Airborne Screaming Eagles parachuted into France, and soon found themselves trapped in a 12th-century Norman church in the small village of Angoville-au-Plain. Medics Robert Wright and Kenneth Moore provided first aid to the first casualties of D-Day while a savage battle raged outside between American and German forces. During the documentary, Wright and Moore recount the rigors of basic training, parachuting into Normandy ahead of the amphibious landing on Utah Beach, surviving German anti-aircraft artillery and carrying on their life-saving work even when their unit retreated. EAGLES OF MERCY supplements these compelling stories with newsreel footage, re-enactments and interviews with fellow medics and residents of Angoville.

programme.title: Dick Winters: Hang Tough
programme.desc: Richard D. Winters was a WWII soldier who always led from the front with the well-being of his men as his top priority. This film, narrated by actor Damian Lewis, honors one of World War II's finest and most respected combat leaders.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we take you to historic Saint Francisville, Louisiana. We closed on a couple of real estate properties in this area and want to show you why this area is so unique from a recreational standpoint. This place holds the “old south” feel that is ever so fleeting. We hunt on a property I sold to a client last year in Saint Francisville and manage to get a beautiful longbearded turkey on the ground. This episode is one you definitely don’t want to miss.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive into how we are using our knowledge and experience to not only get some amazing hunting property, but to have other people pay for it. Sound too good to be true? We also take you on some great hunts we’ve had on our journey flipping land and think back on some memories from the past and what the future is going to look like. We hope you can learn a thing or two in this episode and encourage you to reach out with any questions you may have about this process.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade takes you on a ride through one of the coolest cities in the south, the historic Natchez, Mississippi. This is an area in which Slade sells a lot of hunting land and being only 40 minutes from where he grew up, Slade is very familiar with all there is to do in the area not only from a recreational standpoint but also for entertainment. Slade takes you through the showing process on a beautiful piece of property and bring it full circle at the closing. You’ll also watch a deer hunt with Slade in Natchez that was featured on Realtree Monster Bucks DVD. This is a jampacked episode with so much to learn and also enjoy. We know you’ll love it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade gives you the grand tour of his home property. Slade’s dream was the same as many others, have a place where he can build a home, raise a family, and also have plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors and chase big rack bucks. Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: WWII U.S. Navy veteran Bill Kruschel recounts a journey from humble beginnings in the midst of the Great Depression to his valuable service in the Navy, culminating in a lifelong commitment to the field of special education.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Don Weber recounts his amazing journey through survivors guilt, PTSD and starting over.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Carlos Powell tells of family sacrifice and fighting his post service “demons.”

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Denny McMahan on this episode at the legendary Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas. Denny was nominated by his wife for Bucks for the Brave program hosted by Trinity Oaks. After dedicating his life to service in the US Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy. Denny is a true hero in his community - someone who sacrifices his time, his well being, and his life in service to others, never asking for anything in return.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Jennifer Brooks has spent her life answering the call to serve. From flying Blackhawk helicopters on multiple combat missions during two tours in Iraq to now serving as an Air Medical Pilot and first responder, her story is one of courage, sacrifice, and humility. In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: The bond between and parent and child can grow in many ways, but nothing compares to the bond shared when hunting. The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters has becoming a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin and in 2021, Gavin was able to take his largest buck to date, with his dad Heath behind the camera.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We find ourselves fishing with Troy from Lonestar Beer. Not only is Troy a great friend he is also a big supporter of Hunters Extravaganza. We get to catch up in the offseason and spend a day on the water discussing future events and reflect on what all Texas has to offer.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: With over 20 years of service, retiring as a Senior Chief Machinery Technician, Steven served abord multiple Coast Guard cutters, led critical missions, protected our nation's leaders, and earned the Coast Guard Achievement Medal for his outstanding service. Beyond the uniform, Steven has has spent decades giving back - coaching youth sports, mentoring young athletes, and living the values of service, leadership, and integrity. Steven's dedication didn't end with retirement - and neither does our gratitude. We were honored to have Steven at Thumbtack Ranch and are even more grateful for his service.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life

With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.desc: This week we dive into whitetail anatomy to explain the science behind a humane harvest. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog, Beth and the posse are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days and take care of final details but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to capture.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When the team hunts for Steven, a fugitive with a history of domestic abuse, they seek help from his girlfriend, who's been a victim of his abuse. Meanwhile, Beth trains for a 5K race to help raise awareness about domestic abuse.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket--Heidi and Stephanie. Heidi is a check forger who's failed to make a court appearance.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Tim's got a big problem on his hands. One of his clients, Owen, has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: It's been raining for days and the team is going a little stir crazy. Dog however has the cure--a good hunt. Maui has failed to appear on a drug charge and the team has just one lead.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: As Dog likes to say, "it's not the years it's the miles," and this goes for both men and machines. Those long hunts and the rides to jail take a toll not only on Dog but also on his vehicles.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources--the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond because 18-year-old Ginger is selling drugs and running wild.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is back hunting in the big city of Denver, but chasing fugitives on the mainland is more dangerous than ever. So Dog decides that the crew should get pepper-ball guns, which have much better range than pepper spray.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog decides to help two of his bondsmen buddies, Dave "Red" Widhelm and "Downtown" Bobby Brown. First up is Red, who has a client named Alvin who failed to appear on a $20,000 bond with charges of drug possession and distribution pending.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog leads the team on another adrenaline-filled chase in Denver. The fugitive, Robert, has a habit of address-hopping that makes him a difficult target, but Dog refuses to give up and finally tracks Robert down in his latest hideaway.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: The team is still in Colorado, and today Dog starts his day by to giving his kids and crew a sample of their western heritage by taking them horseback riding. This hunt takes Dog back to his old stomping grounds in Denver.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog's time is running out in Colorado. After a month of helping his bail bondsmen friends around Denver, he's got to get his family back home to Hawaii. But Dog wants one more capture before they leave.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Colorado bondsman Bobby Brown's got trouble and his name is Jackson. Weighing in at over 240lbs and standing six foot tall this bad boy has skipped out on a $10,000 bond.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: With twelve kids of his own Dog knows how hard it is to keep children on the straight and narrow, especially during their turbulent teens.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: A one-hour special that looks back at 2006, one of Dog's most tumultuous years, which has included the passing of Beth's father, Dog and Beth's wedding, the tragic death of Dog's daughter Barbara, and the sudden arrest of Dog, Tim, and Leland.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog usually takes his job personally, but this time a case really hits home. First, he and Beth receive a special gift--a painting of Dog's recently deceased daughter, Barbara Katy.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog finds himself fighting two enemies--the law and his inner demons. He continues his legal battle to fight extradition to Mexico in connection with his 2003 capture of fugitive rapist Andrew Luster. His other struggle is private.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog shows his love of justice and children in this poignant episode. He begins by giving encouragement to a group of handicapped children and making them honorary members of his posse.
